C0128.title: Shanghai White-Collar Worker Sentenced for Exploiting Parking Discounts via SMS Verification Code App
C0128.summary: Between August and December 2020, a Shanghai-based white-collar worker surnamed Li exploited the 'Hesheng Tong' app's new member parking promotion at Hopson One Plaza. Using the 'Juma JieMa' app to purchase virtual phone numbers and verification codes, he registered fake new accounts to accumulate points and redeem free parking time, defrauding the mall of over 5,000 yuan in parking fees.
